title: Data source research candidate
description: One evaluated candidate from the research-sources procedure. Written to research/candidates/<slug>.json. See .claude/skills/research-sources/SKILL.md for the procedure that produces these.

publisher.description: Issuing agency or organization, e.g. 'Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)'.

url.description: Primary URL for the data (download page or direct file/API).

coverage.description: Geographic/market coverage, e.g. 'National, all US counties'.

history_start.description: Earliest available observation, e.g. '1971' or 'varies by geography'.

login_required.description: Whether any account/signup is needed for the access path actually proposed (not necessarily every access path the publisher offers).

license.description: License/ToS summary, including any citation or redistribution requirements.

rate_limit.description: Any request/row limits on the proposed access path, if applicable.

proposed_use.description: Where this would plug into the screener: which scoring pillar, assumption, or display field.

correlation.description: Quantitative evaluation vs FHFA HPI growth / Zillow ZORI, if app/research/evaluate_series.py exists and was run. Null if that tooling doesn't exist yet (qualitative evaluation only).
